program_or_activity: Risk Management Agency Federal Crop Insurance Corporation

when_correct_amount_is_determinable: Company reports corrected indemnity, payment, and premium data
Company pays policyholder underpaid indemnity or overpaid premium
Company pays FCIC overpaid indemnity or underpaid premium and excess subsidy

component_decision.component: published Final Finding dispute, correction, repayment-discretion, and setoff governance
component_decision.basis: Official RMA memoranda and the 2022 SRA publish a controlled path from an appealable Final Finding to possible correction, payment, final administrative review, and setoff while preserving repayment discretion and appeal rights.

state_transition_boundary.reason: The finding can be disputed with rebuttal evidence; contractual interest may accrue during appeal when FCIC has issued a final determination or written specific amount.
FCIC may waive, reduce, or delay repayment, and unpaid amounts may proceed to setoff.
The SRA expressly preserves administrative appeal of the indebtedness involved.

recoverable_savings_residuals: FY2024 sample-specific Final Finding count and dollar amount
affirmed, modified, reversed, withdrawn, and pending appeal amounts
established debt after final administrative review
waived, reduced, and delayed repayment amounts
cash collections and setoffs by sample cohort and period
reconciliation to the projected improper-payment estimate
evidence_boundaries: The procedural memoranda are marked until rescinded and define governance; they do not prove that every FY2024 sample finding followed every possible step.
The 2022 SRA governs the sample reinsurance year but contractual authority is not evidence of an exercised remedy or collected amount.
A Final Finding is appealable and cannot be equated automatically with final collectible debt, even though a written specific amount may accrue interest during appeal.
A payment requirement can be waived, reduced, delayed, disputed, or offset and is not automatically a cash collection.
Nothing in these sources publishes FY2024 sample-specific appeal outcomes, final debt amounts, collectible amounts, collections, prevention, control cost, or savings.
This bridge is period-specific to the 2022 SRA and does not present current legal advice.
